name: The Kept Bench

levels.entry: A glasshouse in a clearing, panes mostly whole, benches and seed trays inside.
The trays are sorted and labelled, and the labels face out so they can be read from the aisle. Somebody works here.
Grass seed, mostly, and steppe varieties -- and a shelf of soil samples from ground that is not local, each one worse than the last.
The dust is weeks deep, not years. Whoever keeps this is coming back to it.
They are not growing food here. They are working out what will grow in dirt that has stopped growing anything, which is a much stranger thing to be doing in a forest this healthy.

notes: Ends unresolved: described exactly, explained not at all.
